messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands facing the camera, then turns her head and upper body to her right, before turning back to face forward.","camera":"The camera maintains a static, medium-shot framing from the waist up at a slightly low angle.","clothing":"She wears a white sleeveless dress with a brown floral lace pattern and a grey chainmail coif draped over her shoulders.","hair_color":"Her hair is a medium brown color.","hairstyle":"Her hair is styled in two high buns on top of her head with straight bangs across her forehead.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young woman with a slender build, light skin, and a neutral facial expression.","scene":"The setting is an indoor corridor with tiled walls, a large round wall clock, and a ribbed orange column on the right."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output starts in a closer front upper-body framing, roughly from the waist up, matching the reference direction and placement. The character’s turn to the right and return to front is preserved, and the corridor, clock, column, clothing, hair, and facial appearance remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera setup to an upper-body front shot, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing while preserving the person, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: The exact camera movement after the first frame is difficult to verify from the sampled frames, though the visible framing remains an upper-body front shot.
